scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:terminal && npm run build:monaco && npm run build:code-workspace && npm run build:drop && npm run build:council && npm run build:cypher && npm run build:waz
scripts.build:renderer: tsc -p src/renderer/tsconfig.json && shx cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/home.html src/renderer/styles.css src/renderer/browser.html src/renderer/context.html dist/renderer/ && shx cp -r src/renderer/fonts dist/renderer/ && shx cp node_modules/chart.js/dist/chart.umd.min.js dist/renderer/
scripts.build:terminal: esbuild src/renderer/terminal-renderer.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/terminal-bundle.js --platform=browser && shx cp node_modules/@xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css src/renderer/terminal.html dist/renderer/
scripts.build:monaco: shx cp src/renderer/monaco.html dist/renderer/ && shx cp -r node_modules/monaco-editor/min/vs dist/renderer/monaco
scripts.build:code-workspace: esbuild src/renderer/code-workspace.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/code-workspace-bundle.js --platform=browser && esbuild src/renderer/code-preload.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/main/code-workspace-preload.js --platform=node --external:electron && shx cp src/renderer/code-workspace.html dist/renderer/
scripts.build:drop: esbuild src/renderer/drop.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/drop.js --platform=browser && esbuild src/renderer/drop-preload.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/main/drop-preload.js --platform=node --external:electron && shx cp src/renderer/drop.html dist/renderer/
scripts.build:council: esbuild src/renderer/council.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/council.js --platform=browser && esbuild src/renderer/council-preload.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/main/council-preload.js --platform=node --external:electron && shx cp src/renderer/council.html dist/renderer/
scripts.build:cypher: esbuild src/renderer/cypher.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/cypher.js --platform=browser && esbuild src/renderer/cypher-preload.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/main/cypher-preload.js --platform=node --external:electron && shx cp src/renderer/cypher.html dist/renderer/
scripts.build:waz: esbuild src/renderer/waz.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/waz.js --platform=browser && esbuild src/renderer/waz-preload.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/main/waz-preload.js --platform=node --external:electron && shx cp src/renderer/waz.html dist/renderer/
